verdict.rationale: Companies House runs a public REST API with a developer documentation suite (guides on authorisation, rate limiting and versioning), so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence item mentions an OpenAPI, Swagger or equivalent spec file that can be downloaded. The human-readable guides and a live API endpoint do not count as a machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
